artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
local function round_to(n: number, decimals: number): number
    local mult = 10 ^ decimals
    if n >= 0 then
        return math.floor(n * mult + 0.5) / mult
    else
        return math.ceil(n * mult - 0.5) / mult
    end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial = input.initial_value
    local current = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local raw_change = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local percentage = round_to(raw_change, 2)

    local direction = "flat"
    if current > initial then
        direction = "up"
    elseif current < initial then
        direction = "down"
    end

    return { percentage_change = percentage, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change between two values (rounded to 2 decimals) and direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change and whether a value moved up, down, or stayed flat.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- List customers in the segment
    local list_r = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not list_r.ok then
        return { error = list_r.error, message = list_r.message }
    end

    local customers = list_r.customers or {}
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sends_done: number = 0
    local max_sends: number = 10

    for _, cust in customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if sends_done >= max_sends then
                break
            end
            local text = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
            local send_r = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            if not send_r.ok then
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
            end
            sends_done += 1
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Accept numeric input; coerce if necessary, default to 0 for safety
    local c = input.celsius
    if type(c) ~= "number" then
        local n = tonumber(c)
        if type(n) == "number" then
            c = n
        else
            c = 0
        end
    end

    local f = c * 9 / 5 + 32
    return { fahrenheit = f }
end

artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
  -- Validate initial value
  local initial = input.initial_value
  local current = input.current_value
  if initial == 0 then
    return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
  end

  -- Helper: round to two decimal places (handles negative values correctly)
  local function round2(n: number): number
    if n >= 0 then
      return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    else
      return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
    end
  end

  local raw_change = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
  local percentage = round2(raw_change)

  -- Determine direction based on actual values
  local direction = "flat"
  if current > initial then
    direction = "up"
  elseif current < initial then
    direction = "down"
  end

  return { percentage_change = percentage, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change between initial and current values, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a rounded percent change and simple direction (up/down/flat) between two numeric values.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output

    if not list_r.ok then
        return { error = list_r.error, message = list_r.message }
    end

    local candidates: { CustomerRef } = {}
    for _, c in list_r.customers do
        if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            table.insert(candidates, c)
        end
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local send_limit: number = 10
    local total: number = #candidates
    local to_send: number = total
    if to_send > send_limit then
        to_send = send_limit
    end

    for i = 1, to_send do
        local cust = candidates[i]
        local text = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
        local r = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
        if not r.ok then
            table.insert(failed, cust.id)
        else
            table.insert(notified, cust.id)
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
